d:
To escape Bapuji's scolding over delaying his maintenance cheque, Jethalal lies that he already deposited it inside the locked society office. Confident that Jethalal is bluffing, Bhide wagers an uthak-baithak (sit-up) challenge against Champaklal when opening the office to verify.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
